target.validation_method: root SSH target probe; no computer-use visual inspection

build_validation.pcm_fifo_mapping: Both FIFO halves inferred as dual-port M10K (fifo_rtl_0 and fifo_rtl_1).
build_validation.host_and_arm_tests: Transport control, framebuffer scanout, PCM ordering/starvation/recovery, long 480-record PCM drain, DDR arbiter, host ABI and Cortex-A9 QEMU checks passed.

hardware_validation.clean_boot: Board rebooted, new RBF loaded, and FPGA manager reported operating.
hardware_validation.control_attachment: ARM probe reported epoch 0xd1a61001 and fpga_state=ready.
hardware_validation.pcm_queue: ARM published 480 stereo S16 records; FPGA consumed the queue to producer=consumer=480.
hardware_validation.framebuffer_regression: On the same new RBF, two ARM-published frames were claimed by FPGA scanout and the retired slot was reclaimed.

scope_limit: This proves the synthesized ARM-to-FPGA PCM queue and shared-DDR arbitration on the board. Physical speaker/HDMI audio channel inspection, underrun qualification under real Diablo load, input traffic and performance qualification remain open.
